summary: Beacon Topco filed an 8-K disclosing a Second Amendment to its September 29, 2025 Agreement and Plan of Merger among Topco, Beacon (a UK target acquired via scheme of arrangement on September 9, 2026), Merger Sub and Clywedog Therapeutics. The amendment fixes the closing on October 31, 2026, or earlier by mutual consent, and resets the End Date to October 31, 2026, replacing the prior timeline. The merger remains a two-step structure: a UK scheme of arrangement equivalent to a US merger, followed by a Delaware merger of Merger Sub into Clywedog, leaving Clywedog as a wholly owned Topco subsidiary. No price, premium, stake, board recommendation or advisor terms are stated, and the filing includes a clinical press release rather than deal economics. Watch for completion confirmation and any further timeline extensions or financing conditions before the October 31 outside date, as repeated amendments can signal closing friction.
